summary: BlackRock filed a prospectus supplement to register shares of common stock issuable upon redemption of SubCo Units held by former HPS Investment Partners sellers. Up to 12,035,866 shares are registered, consisting of ~7.6M shares issuable upon redemption of initial closing consideration SubCo Units and up to ~4.4M deferred consideration units subject to performance milestones. Redemptions are at the option of Subco members after the one-year anniversary of the July 2025 closing, with BlackRock able to elect a direct exchange of shares on a one-for-one basis. No new event; this is a routine shelf takedown to satisfy existing contractual obligations. No price, premium, or board recommendation disclosed. What to watch: potential dilution from future unit redemptions.
